0022600023.text: The Golden State Warriors, 1-3 and 12th in the West, host the Los Angeles Lakers in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, with Los Angeles at 3-1, first in the Pacific, and coming off a loss. Golden State is without Gui Santos (knee tendinitis), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back), and Ziaire Williams (foot). The Warriors trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 127-105 in Los Angeles on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
